_about: Settings of checker.py. Every number and file name the checker uses lives here or in the lists next to it; style thresholds live only in style_thresholds.json.
_ending_words_source: S03 prompt; PLAN_ACTION beat 6 asks the last 20 s (about 50 words) to announce the next video
_signature_hash_chars_source: S04 prompt, task 0: Signed: Franco, YYYY-MM-DD, sha256:<12 hex>
_quote_min_words_source: same as measure.py dialogue: a quoted span of two words or more is a quotation; one quoted word is a scare quote
_sourced_sections_source: audit C2 (S05): a number in a title or a thumbnail text cites the fact that holds it, as [^Fnn]
_scenes_source: S05 prompt task 1 and PLAN_ACTION section 2: 85-95 scenes of 9-10 s, 50-55 Gemini images, 25-30 charts drawn from 02b_factcheck.md, 4-5 Flow clips, 6 chapter cards; one 'WHO PAYS?' title card at the start of the setup (PLAN_ACTION: 'carte de titre identique a 0:45'). Words per scene: 9-10 s at 149 wpm is 22-25 words, warned outside 10-40 (assumed). Same motion at most 3 in a row and on-screen text on at most one scene in three: Zehon step 4 rules, kept
